sloka: नद्ध वैदूर्य संकाशम् तप्त कान्चन कुण्डलम् ।सुभुजम् शुक्ल दशनम् महा आस्यम् पर्वतोपमम् ॥३-३२-९॥
transliteration: naddha vaidūrya saṁkāśam tapta kāncana kuṇḍalam ।subhujam śukla daśanam mahā āsyam parvatopamam ॥3-32-9॥

translations.english: Wearing burnished golden earrings, he looked bright like the glittering vaidurya. And with his wellformed arms, white teeth and wide mouth, he looked like a mountain.
